services.summary: Valkey, a Redis-compatible key-value store.
services.description: Valkey, the BSD-licensed Redis fork

runtime.start:
umask 077
acl="$STACK_DATA_DIR/users.acl"
if [ ! -e "$acl" ]; then
  printf 'user default on >%s ~* &* +@all\n' "$VALKEY_ADMIN_PASSWORD" > "$acl"
fi
exec "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/valkey-server" "$@" --port "$STACK_PORT" --bind 127.0.0.1 --dir "$STACK_DATA_DIR" --unixsocket "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR/valkey.sock" --appendonly no --aclfile "$acl"

runtime.provision:
set -eu
result="$(printf 'ACL SETUSER %s reset on >%s ~* &* +@all -@admin\nACL SAVE\n' "$STACK_GROUP" "$REDIS_PASSWORD" | VALKEYCLI_AUTH="$VALKEY_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/valkey-cli" -s "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR/valkey.sock" --no-auth-warning 2>&1)"
if [ "$result" != "$(printf 'OK\nOK')" ]; then
  printf 'Valkey refused the group account: %s\n' "$result" >&2
  exit 1
fi

site_server.name: PHP-FPM
site_server.title: PHP
site_server.config:
; #stack-generated
[global]
daemonize = no
error_log = /dev/stderr
log_limit = 65536

[www]
listen = ${STACK_LISTEN}
listen.mode = 0600
pm = dynamic
pm.max_children = 5
pm.start_servers = 1
pm.min_spare_servers = 1
pm.max_spare_servers = 3
catch_workers_output = yes
decorate_workers_output = no
php_value[log_errors] = On
clear_env = no

services.summary: S3-compatible object storage, buckets per group.
services.description: versitygw, an S3 gateway over a plain directory

runtime.provision:
set -ef
export ADMIN_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$ROOT_ACCESS_KEY"
export ADMIN_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$ROOT_SECRET_KEY"
export ADMIN_ENDPOINT_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$STACK_PORT"

admin() {
  "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/versitygw" admin "$@"
}

for bucket in $STACK_BUCKETS; do
  admin list-buckets | awk '{print $1}' | grep -qx "$bucket" ||
    admin create-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --owner "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
done

init.script:
set -ef
present() { /usr/local/bin/versitygw admin "$1" | awk -v value="$2" 'NR>2 && $1==value {found=1} END{exit !found}'; }
present list-users "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ||
  /usr/local/bin/versitygw admin create-user --access "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" --secret "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" --role user
for bucket in $STACK_BUCKETS; do
  present list-buckets "$bucket" ||
    /usr/local/bin/versitygw admin create-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --owner "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
done

recipes.title: Private and public buckets
recipes.yaml:
group: shop
services:
  - name: files
    type: s3
    buckets:
      - {name: uploads}
      - {name: public, publish: true}
recipes.gives: Gives S3_PRIVATE_BUCKET=b.shop.uploads, S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET=b.shop.public and S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://public.s3.shop.test, with S3_ENDPOINT, the S3_* and AWS_* access keys and the AWS_* endpoint settings.

    buckets:

recipes.gives: Gives MEDIA_BUCKET=b.shop.media, MEDIA_ENDPOINT, MEDIA_DEFAULT_REGION, MEDIA_ACCESS_KEY_ID, MEDIA_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and an empty MEDIA_URL, as the bucket is not published, beside the service's own variables.

recipes.gives: Gives a bucket that answers CORS requests from https://app.shop.test with GET, HEAD and PUT.
